sources.title: Magistral Small 1.2 model reference and Weights table
sources.evidence: Exact magistral-small-2509 reference. The delivered React payload links this checkpoint and explicitly reports Parameters (B)=24 and Active (B)=24. Supports text/image input, reasoning/text output and function calling. Page gives September 18, 2025, conflicting with the changelog; marks deprecation April 30, 2026.

sources.title: Magistral Small 1.2 pinned model card
sources.evidence: Names this exact revision, identifies 24B parameters and Apache 2.0, and documents its added vision encoder and native THINK tokens. Built on Mistral Small 3.2 with supervised training on Magistral Medium traces followed by RL. Advertises 128k context, warns performance may degrade past 40k, and recommends retaining 128k unless performance suffers. Supplies native reasoning and tool parser settings.

sources.title: Magistral Small 2509 pinned Transformers configuration
sources.evidence: Mistral3ForConditionalGeneration: a 40-layer dense Mistral language decoder (hidden size 5120, intermediate size 32768, 32 query and 8 KV heads) with max_position_embeddings 131072, plus a 24-layer Pixtral vision encoder and multimodal projector. BF16, with no quantization configuration.

sources.title: Magistral Small 2509 pinned native configuration
sources.evidence: Independently confirms dense feed-forward dimensions and 40 decoder layers, 131072 positions, plus native 24-layer image encoder and patch-merge adapter.

sources.title: Magistral Small 2509 pinned tensor index
sources.evidence: The 585 indexed tensors across ten shards include single gate/up/down feed-forward projections per language layer, vision tower and projector, without expert/router tensors. Used to corroborate architecture, not as an inferred active-parameter count.

sources.title: Mistral official API changelog
sources.evidence: Under September 17, 2025, explicitly announces Magistral Small 1.2 (magistral-small-2509) and Medium 1.2. This is the earliest explicit developer release date found; later reference/legal pages give September 18.

sources.title: Magistral Small 2509 public launch-day model-card contribution
sources.evidence: Read via Hugging Face discussion API. External contribution opened September 17, 2025 at 12:57:53 UTC; Mistral organization member Patrick von Platen replied at 13:41:47 UTC with a completed README update. This corroborates public repository activity on September 17 rather than treating private creation time as release evidence.

sources.title: Magistral Small 1 legal lifecycle record
sources.evidence: Separately identifies revision 1.2 and September 18, 2025. This date conflicts with the explicit API changelog and September 17 public repository activity. Its Active lifecycle label also differs from the API documentation deprecation status.

sources.title: Magistral Small 2509 official checkpoint repository metadata
sources.evidence: Current revision a31cc96ab10cf19bc42c628fedf1e359e0853c49 is public and ungated. Repository contains native and Transformers weights and configurations. Repository creation on September 12 is not used as release evidence.

sources.title: Magistral Small 2509 public checkpoint byte probe
sources.evidence: Unauthenticated bounded request returned HTTP 206, Content-Range bytes 0-7/4883550696; read exactly eight bytes of the first shard. Confirms public weight access without downloading a full shard.

sources.title: Magistral Small 1.2 official Markdown reference
sources.evidence: Exact API identifier, text/image input, reasoning/text output, function calling, Apache 2.0, 128k context. Records API deprecation April 30, 2026 and retirement July 31, 2026; not proof of an operating current endpoint.

name.note: Developer revision name distinguishes 2509 from the June and July releases.

developer.note: Official Mistral documentation and repository; retain normalized developer label.

family.note: Exact card and documentation place the revision in the Magistral family.

release_date.note: Use the earliest explicit first-party release announcement, corroborated by same-day public maintainer interaction. The September 18 date in model-reference/legal pages is retained as a conflict; private repository creation is excluded.

open_weights.note: Official checkpoint is public and ungated; bounded unauthenticated shard access succeeded.

license.note: Explicit license in exact model card and weights table; normalize spelling. No standalone LICENSE file was present in the repository listing.

parameters_b.note: Developer nominal whole-model size in billions. Not asserted to equal exactly 24,000,000,000 learned weights.

active_parameters_b.note: Direct nominal Active (B)=24 disclosure in the exact checkpoint row; not inferred by equating dense active and total counts.

architecture.note: Configuration and indexed single-MLP-per-layer structure establish a dense Transformer language decoder, with native Pixtral vision encoder and projector.

context_window.note: Both exact checkpoint configurations specify 131072 positions. Card advertises 128k and recommends it, with possible quality degradation past 40k; this warning is not a lower hard context limit.

modalities.note: Native image encoder is present. Reasoning traces are text output and represented separately by the reasoning flag, not a new physical modality.

reasoning.note: Exact revision explicitly supports native thinking tokens and reasoning output.

tool_call.note: Exact model reference explicitly lists function calling; official card supplies native Mistral tool parser and automatic tool choice serving settings. This does not certify every third-party integration.

description.value: Multimodal reasoning model for text and image inputs, with native tool calling.
description.note: Replace vague transparency wording with the documented modalities, reasoning and tool capability.

patch.description: Multimodal reasoning model for text and image inputs, with native tool calling.
patch.notes: Mistral explicitly reports nominal 24B total and 24B active parameters. Native text/image input and text output with reasoning and tool calls. The checkpoint context is 131,072 tokens; the card warns quality may degrade past 40k but recommends keeping 128k. Release date follows the September 17, 2025 API changelog and same-day public maintainer activity; model-reference and legal pages give September 18. API docs record deprecation on April 30, 2026 and retirement on July 31, 2026; public weights remain downloadable.

summary: Audited all 14 fields for Magistral Small 1.2. Adds directly disclosed nominal 24B total and 24B active parameters, dense multimodal Transformer architecture and primary provenance. Confirms Apache-2.0, public weights, 131072 checkpoint context, reasoning and native tool calling. Moves release date to the explicit September 17 API announcement, corroborated by public maintainer activity, while preserving September 18 reference/legal conflict. Notes the model-card long-context quality warning and historical API retirement.
